final_answer:
Microsoft's gross margin improved from FY2023 to FY2024.

- FY2023 (year ended June 30, 2023): Revenue $211,915M; Cost of revenue $65,863M → Gross margin ≈ 68.92% [DOC: msft_margin.txt]
- FY2024 (year ended June 30, 2024): Revenue $245,122M; Cost of revenue $74,114M → Gross margin ≈ 69.76% [DOC: msft_margin.txt]

Both figures come from the same fiscal-year reporting basis (Microsoft's fiscal year ends June 30) as presented in the FY2024 10-K, so the periods are directly comparable.

Gross margin improved by approximately 0.84 percentage points (from ~68.92% to ~69.76%).

ANSWER: Improved by approximately 0.8 percentage points (from ~68.9% in FY2023 to ~69.8% in FY2024).
